method.network: native physical interface binding; one public DoH IP snapshot shared by all requests; no proxy or relay
method.initial: Chrome131, HTTP/2, matched Windows browser UA, GET without Range
method.forced_interruption: after retaining first 256 KiB for reconnect arms; new Client and TCP/TLS connection
method.reattempts: same URL and pinned IP; same Range/If-Range, strong ETag and exact Content-Range validation; 200 restarts safely
method.timing: entire initial attempt plus cut/reconnect/remaining body; SHA256 afterward
method.interpretation: forced interruption is a controlled experiment, not natural slow-link recovery success rate
method.telemetry: nettop restricted to each test PID; raw IPs, ports and process names remain in scratch only

tcp.note: per-socket lifetime maxima; do not sum repeated samples; client retransmits do not measure server-side retransmits
